VERIFICATION

Glanvu is published by the software author (Juan García Longarón) on GitHub:
  https://github.com/glanvu/glanvu/releases/tag/v0.12.0

This package downloads the official Windows release zip and verifies its SHA256:

  File:   Glanvu-0.12.0-windows-x86_64.zip
  SHA256: 709C16F6341B706708EAB0611EAA19A9737FFC264F8AB3540E847810788C0203

To verify the checksum yourself:

  PowerShell:
    Get-FileHash .\Glanvu-0.12.0-windows-x86_64.zip -Algorithm SHA256

  GitHub CLI:
    gh release view v0.12.0 --repo glanvu/glanvu --json assets `
      --jq '.assets[] | select(.name | endswith("windows-x86_64.zip")) | .digest'
